name: Noir
source:
A lupine beastman of indeterminate age.
Despite her size, she's a mysterious girl who's brash and has a presence about her. She overcomes the persecution faced by many of her kind and lives life to the full.

Although highly wary of people she first meets, once she takes a liking to someone she opens up and treats them evenly regardless of race, gender or age.

Her appearance belies her considerable sexual experience and she often enjoys taking the lead in sexual encounters.

[Spoiler] Born to a community of beastmen living in the shallower regions of the mountain, the only source of entertainment in such a small community was fighting monsters in the nearby confines. Despite suffering injuries frequently, Noir became strong enough to explore the mountain solo. An encounter with the doppelganger monster left her near death, but she was rescued by Adria and her party of Tora guild adventurers.

As Ariad refuses to accept non-humans into the ranks of his guild, Adria had no choice but to ask Edgar for help in taking Noir in. Being perpetually understaffed and with no prejudices against potential newcomers, Edger was happy to take Noir in.

Noir's status as a minority beastman and her petite appearance make her the target of bullies. However, she is so strong most aggressors are taught a lesson. In addition, fighting makes her sexually excited and she has to satisfy her urges. If Edgar is not available, she will rape males who attempt to assault her for whatever reason. [/Spoiler]
